nodes.en: An actual nef adjoint after nonvanishing

nodes.ja: 正の飯高次元を処理し、残りで零因子を取る
nodes.en: Settle positive Iitaka dimension; take a zero divisor in the remainder

nodes.ja: 台が消えないsupported nefモデル
nodes.en: A supported nef model with surviving support

nodes.ja: 境界生成と持ち上げの矛盾
nodes.en: Boundary generation and lifting give a contradiction

edges.ja: crepantなQ-factorialモデルでHLLを適用し、生成を元の空間へ降ろす。
edges.en: Apply HLL on a crepant Q-factorial model and descend generation to the original space.

edges.ja: floorに台を合わせるsupported program。元のnefnessと例外negativityで非零台を保つ。
edges.en: Run the supported program with exact floor support; original nefness and exceptional negativity preserve nonzero support.

edges.ja: 特別な解消で全floorを生成し、次に持ち上げる。矛盾から元の零因子はゼロ。
edges.en: The special resolution gives generation on the whole floor, then lifting; the contradiction forces the original zero divisor to vanish.

nodes.ja: 同じ周囲の線束を持つnormal strata
nodes.en: Normal strata carrying one ambient line
Finite images in a fixed degree

nodes.ja: 全交差で整合し、被約floorを生成
nodes.en: Match every intersection and generate the reduced floor

edges.ja: DOで三次元成分を生成。torsion-freeな障害とMori fiberが延長条件を一つのlinkへ帰着。
edges.en: DO generates the three-dimensional components; a torsion-free obstruction and a Mori fibre reduce extension to one link.

edges.ja: 非射影曲面では三次元strata由来のlinkだけを使い、一つのKähler類を輸送する。
edges.en: For nonprojective surfaces use only links from three-dimensional strata and transport one ambient Kähler class.

edges.ja: 下位から延長しnorm積で不変化。有限超平面回避で非消滅を保ち、全floorへ降下。
edges.en: Extend from lower strata and take invariant norms; avoid finitely many hyperplanes and descend to the whole floor.

nodes.ja: 生成された全floorからroot近傍へ
nodes.en: From the generated whole floor to root neighborhoods
nodes.math: $f:S\to\mathbb P^b,\quad E\text{ reduced Cartier},\quad I=\mathcal O_Z(-E)$

nodes.ja: 障害を失わないsplit residue挿入
nodes.en: Split residue insertion retains every obstruction

nodes.ja: ample lineからsymbol kernelへの写像を消す
nodes.en: Kill the ample-line map into the symbol kernel

nodes.ja: 全整数次数・全有限次数で持ち上げ
nodes.en: Lift in all integer degrees and finite orders

nodes.ja: 不変層の反復から周囲の切断を増やす
nodes.en: Recurring invariant layers grow ambient sections

edges.ja: 第二のcanonical rootと導来retractionが、特殊パラメータに台を持つ第一cohomologyも保つ。
edges.en: A second canonical root and derived retraction retain first-cohomology classes supported at special parameters.

edges.ja: constant strataのstrict直像とpure商のvanishing。非分岐点を選ぶcompact graph上でadjugateを使う。
edges.en: Use strict direct images of constant strata and vanishing on pure quotients; apply the adjugate on a compact graph unbranched at the chosen point.

edges.ja: 任意の指定点へ降下し、局所恒等式とLaurent導分則で残る障害を消す。
edges.en: Descend at an arbitrary prescribed point; the local identity and Laurent derivation rule kill the remaining obstruction.

edges.ja: 巡回不変部分のcoherent層商にSerre vanishingを適用。最後の損失は固定の第一cohomology。
edges.en: Apply Serre vanishing to coherent invariant layer quotients; the final loss is bounded by fixed first cohomology.
